div.head: Ine 7
div.ab: Gif hwa stalige, swa his wif (hit) nyte ⁊ his bearn, gesylle LX scll' to wite.
LI. Gif hwa stalie, swa his wíf nyte ⁊ his bearn, geselle LX scill. to wite.
Si quis furetur sic, ut uxor eius nesciat (hoc) et pueri sui, reddat wite LX sol.
{LI} Gif swa stalie, swa his wíf nyte ⁊ his bearn, geselle LX sciƚƚ to wite.
If someone steals, but his wife and his child(ren) do not know it, let him pay 60 shillings as a fine.
If anyone steals without the cognisance of his wife and children, he shall pay a fine of 60 shillings.
If anyone steals without his wife and his children knowing, he is to pay 60 shillings as a fine.
Wenn einer stiehlt, vorausgesetzt, sein Weib und seine Nachkommenschaft wissen [es] nicht, so gebe er 60 Schill. zur Strafe.
If someone steals, provided his wife and his offspring do not know [of it], let him give 60 shillings as a fine.
